{
  "precursors": ["WF6"],
  "coreactants": ["atomic hydrogen (at-H)"],
  "purge_gas": ["Ar"],
  "carrier_gas": ["Ar"],
  "evidence": "Tungsten films were deposited by this method using alternating pulses of WF6 gas and atomic hydrogen (at-H). The latter was generated by catalytic dissociation of molecular hydrogen (H2) upon the hot-wire. Molecular hydrogen (H2) carried by argon gas (Ar) was introduced into the chamber via the hot-wire port (top). WF6 carried by Ar was admitted via the gas ring a few cm above the substrate."
}
